license_required.quote: it is unlawful for an individual to practice or attempt to practice podiatry or to claim to be licensed as a podiatrist without first obtaining a license to practice podiatry as provided in this chapter

issuing_authority.value: Board of Licensure of Podiatric Medicine
issuing_authority.quote: "Board" means the Board of Licensure of Podiatric Medicine.

age_minimum.quote: Is at least 18 years of age;

degree_required.value: certificate of graduation from an accredited college of podiatric medicine
degree_required.quote: Has received a certificate of graduation from an accredited college of podiatric medicine, recognized by the Council of Education of the American Podiatry Association or its successor or other organization approved by the board

accrediting_body.value: Council of Education of the American Podiatry Association
accrediting_body.quote: recognized by the Council of Education of the American Podiatry Association or its successor or other organization approved by the board

required.quote: shall provide the board with evidence of satisfactory completion of at least one year of postgraduate clinical training in a podiatric residency training program

duration.quote: satisfactory completion of at least one year of postgraduate clinical training in a podiatric residency training program

kind.quote: postgraduate clinical training in a podiatric residency training program approved by the accrediting body of the American Podiatric Medical Association

exams.name: Board-approved examination
exams.notes: Applicant must pass an examination approved by the board before engaging in the practice of podiatry
exams.quote: an individual must pass an examination approved by the board before engaging in the practice of podiatry

interval_years.quote: shall apply on or before July 1st of every year or at such other time as the Commissioner of Professional and Financial Regulation may designate, to the board for a license renewal

required.quote: the applicant has completed a program of continuing education as prescribed in the rules of the board

hours_per_period.quote: must successfully complete 3 hours of continuing education every 2 years on the prescription of opioid medication

period_years.quote: 3 hours of continuing education every 2 years on the prescription of opioid medication

topical_requirements.quote: 3 hours of continuing education every 2 years on the prescription of opioid medication as a condition of prescribing opioid medication

available.quote: The board may issue a license to practice podiatry by endorsement to an applicant who has successfully passed the written examination of another state or of a national certifying agency in podiatry recognized by the board

requirements.value: Must have passed equivalent written examination of another state or national certifying agency, satisfy all other licensure requirements including residency, and pay applicable fees
requirements.quote: if the written examination of the other state or national certifying agency was equivalent to its own examination and if the applicant satisfies in all other respects the requirements for licensure in section 3651‑A

regulatory_model.quote: it is unlawful for an individual to practice or attempt to practice podiatry or to claim to be licensed as a podiatrist without first obtaining a license to practice podiatry

title_protection.quote: it is unlawful for an individual to practice or attempt to practice podiatry or to claim to be licensed as a podiatrist without first obtaining a license

scope_protection.quote: it is unlawful for an individual to practice or attempt to practice podiatry or to claim to be licensed as a podiatrist without first obtaining a license to practice podiatry as provided in this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Misuse of alcohol, drugs, or other substances that has resulted or may result in endangering patient health or safety
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Misuse of alcohol, drugs or other substances that has resulted or may result in the applicant or licensee performing services in a manner that endangers the health or safety of the licensee's patients

disciplinary_grounds.description: Professional diagnosis of a mental or physical condition that has resulted or may result in endangering patient health or safety
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A professional diagnosis of a mental or physical condition that has resulted or may result in the applicant or licensee performing services in a manner that endangers the health or safety of the podiatrist's patients

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in false, misleading, or deceptive advertising
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in false, misleading or deceptive advertising

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing controlled substances for other than accepted therapeutic purposes
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing narcotic or hypnotic or other drugs listed as controlled substances by the federal Drug Enforcement Administration for other than accepted therapeutic purposes

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with the Controlled Substances Prescription Monitoring Program requirements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with the requirements of Title 22, section 7253.

definition_quote.value: the diagnosis and treatment of maladies of the human foot and ankle by medical, surgical or mechanical means
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of podiatric medicine" means the diagnosis and treatment of maladies of the human foot and ankle by medical, surgical or mechanical means.

methods_authorized.quote: diagnosis and treatment of maladies of the human foot and ankle by medical, surgical or mechanical means

drug_authority.value: May prescribe narcotic drugs for treatment of ailments within scope of license with DEA approval
drug_authority.quote: A licensed podiatrist may prescribe narcotic drugs for the treatment of ailments within the scope of the podiatrist's license with the approval of the Drug Enforcement Administration.

anatomical_scope_upper_boundary.quote: "Practice of podiatric medicine" means the diagnosis and treatment of maladies of the human foot and ankle by medical, surgical or mechanical means.

anesthesia_authority.quote: The use of general anesthesia is permitted in conjunction with the practice of podiatry when administered or supervised by a medical or osteopathic physician who assumes responsibility for the administration of that anesthesia to a patient being treated by a podiatrist.

ankle_surgery_authorized.quote: "Practice of podiatric medicine" means the diagnosis and treatment of maladies of the human foot and ankle by medical, surgical or mechanical means.

podiatric_assistant_authorized.quote: This chapter may not be construed to prohibit a podiatrist from delegating to a podiatric assistant certain activities relating to medical care and treatment that are delegated by custom and usage

podiatric_assistant_supervision_level.quote: those activities are under the supervision or control of the podiatrist, who must be present on the premises at the time the activities are performed

telehealth_authorized.quote: A person licensed under this chapter may provide telehealth services as long as the licensee acts within the scope of practice of the licensee's license

opioid_prescribing_rules_required.quote: The board shall adopt rules to implement this subsection.

controlled_substances_prescribing_ce_req.quote: must successfully complete 3 hours of continuing education every 2 years on the prescription of opioid medication as a condition of prescribing opioid medication

corrective_footwear_exemption.quote: to the sale of nonprescription foot appliances in commercial establishments

impaired_practitioner_program.quote: The board has the power to contract with other agencies, individuals, firms or associations for the conduct and operation of a podiatrist health program operated by a professional review committee.

electronic_prescribing_required.quote: An individual licensed under this chapter and whose scope of practice includes prescribing opioid medication with the capability to electronically prescribe shall prescribe all opioid medication electronically by July 1, 2017.

preoperative_history_and_physical_author.quote: "Practice of podiatric medicine" includes the performance of a history and physical on a podiatrist's preoperative patient and upon the patient's admission into a hospital or ambulatory surgical center.
